title: How Depending Leads to Independence
partialText: True independence isn’t the absence of dependencies. It’s an intentional integration. An assembly that’s clear, chosen and changeable.

title: Nuxt 4 Notes with AppWrite
partialText: Build a basic to-do app using Nuxt 4 and Appwrite for hands-on setup and TablesDB experience.

title: Choosing the Right Telerik UI for Blazor Chart
partialText: Which type of chart is best for your data set? Explore the different types of Blazor charts and get a guide of which to use in certain use cases.

title: Check Out These Amazing Projects from the Progress x GitNation Hackathon!
partialText: We hosted a hackathon in partnership with GitNation, and the response blew us away. In just 48 hours, we got over 30 finished projects! Check out our winners and some of our favorites.

title: Best Practices for Exceptions in ASP.NET Core
partialText: Exceptions are a common approach to dealing with unexpected situations. But are they truly necessary? Let’s see some best practices for using them in ASP.NET Core.

title: REST to tRPC Migration in NestJS Monorepos
partialText: Convert a shared monorepo with a NestJS REST API and Next.js to tRPC. Replace NestJS controllers with typed tRPC routers that expose procedures instead of endpoints, updating the frontend to consume those procedures with fully typed hooks and no manual type definitions.

title: Design Systems, Tokens and AI
partialText: AI can compress the time between a design decision and its implementation when design systems can be updated with tokens.

title: AI Is the Power Loom. And You? Are You the Weaver?
partialText: One senior developer shares his opinions about the ideas that AI is either a temporary trend or a final solution to all tech needs.

title: Blazor Basics: Implementing a Loading Indicator for Asynchronous Components
partialText: Learn how to properly implement a custom loading indicator and why professional UI libraries can provide the best user experience.

title: Handling Mutations with TanStack Query for Vue
partialText: Learn how to handle mutations with TanStack Query in Vue to be able to send data back the server and keep the whole app in sync.

title: Getting Started with NLP Using Hugging Face Transformers in Python
partialText: Learn about natural language processing and explore the Hugging Face Transformers library in Python for tasks like text classification and summarization.

title: Replicating a Ticket Screen in .NET MAUI
partialText: Travel! It’s one of our favorite things, and here is how to build a flight ticket screen in .NET MAUI.

title: Stop Running Your Backlog Like an Emergency Room
partialText: The 3P Triage Framework: why purpose and design come before urgency—and how that changes everything about backlog prioritization.

title: Nuxt 4 Server Routes vs. Fetch Composables
partialText: See a Nuxt app load data from the server in a Server Component and using useFetch to see how Server Components and fetch mechanisms compare.

title: When Status OK Is Still a Failure: A Taxonomy of Silent AI Agent Breakage and How to Detect It
partialText: The Progress AI Observability Python SDK can help debug AI agent tasks that fail despite component reports claiming success.
